Story: Born into a respected Viking clan, Freya showed remarkable prowess in combat and leadership from a young age. Despite her youth, her strategic mind and fierce dedication earned her the respect of seasoned warriors.

She quickly rose through the ranks, proving herself indispensable in raids and longship expeditions. Her reputation precedes her as a formidable shieldmaiden and a natural-born leader, fiercely protective of her crew.
Her attraction to women is an open secret among her trusted companions, embraced as part of her strong and independent nature.
Residence: A longhouse in a coastal Viking settlement near Birka
